text_block_list.text:
At last, I have proven myself the
strongest
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Raise your voices high and fix your eyes
on me as
I forge on.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will show you an even more glorious
victory...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Come and watch me outpace even the
seniors!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's declaration of war is
greeted by
the most deafening cheers of
the day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, as you may well have
gathered...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I intend to leverage this victory into
entering the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Participation is decided by popular vote,
so even
being invited is a mark of
prestige.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But, as I'm certain you know by now,
that will not
suffice. Nothing less than
victory will satisfy me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Haha... As you command.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As we resolve to fix our sights on the
Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.
Good work out there, Prez.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to
watch me
race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the
strongest
Umamusume was.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And as expected, it's you. Looks like the
Kikuka
Sho was no sweat for the
Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I could hardly presume to give you
orders if I
wasn't.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you
someday. You
look like an opponent
worth sinking my teeth
into.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can weather
a gentle
nibble.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Эйр Грув
not with
you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to
assume that
she would be watching... Or
could it be that she
has something to
attend to?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really
your speed.
You make it too obvious.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's not what I—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow you if
you don't
keep an eye on her?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Never mind. Congrats on the win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Get some rest. You've earned it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer... About what Brian
just said—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper. Do
you have
a minute?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Just give me a moment to get
ready.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We can pick this up later. The press is
calling.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Between this win and my future
ambitions, I have
plenty for them to get
excited about.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Симболи Рудольф
winds up
swamped with interviews, and
we never get the
chance to have that
talk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
